name: pluneto-skills
description: Pluneto's agent skills: plan and build workflows, engineering practice, skill authoring, design and UX reviews.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and UX reviews: backend-design-review, dashboard-design, user-types and tool-for-users.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering practice: tdd, diagnosing-bugs, review-changes, pr, prototype, and codebase design and domain modelling (codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture, domain-modeling). Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Set up or repair the pluneto-skills plugins in a repo (/setup:setup-pluneto-skills). Install once at user scope.

plugins.name: skill-tools
plugins.description: Write and maintain skills: writing-for-agents, skill-updater, skill-ozempic and the end-of-session reflect retro.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Plan, build, solve and research goals end to end: plan-this, interview, build-this, solve-this, research-this, use-available-skills, wayfinder, to-tickets, plus handoff, to-questionnaire, wizard and the which-skill router.
